text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Hrrrm... What kind of stream should I 
do tomorrow...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Just advertising won't get more views, 
though... What kind of plan would actually 
go viral...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I'm fine! I think I was just 
overthinking things a bit yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Still, as Tomakomai's Tourism Ambassador, 
this much is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps from overthinking things, Hokko 
Tarumae ended up troubled by a headache...
